message: 紫央ちゃんとさっちん

name: Paqy
message: 「How long are you gonna wait around? Even the Demon Lord oughta know Soba ain't coming, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, let's head to school soon. I'm the Student Council President, I can't be late.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, it's freezing! That sea breeze cuts right through you.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I've made up my mind!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the Student Council President, so it's fine if I'm late. Paqy, I'm going after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If your conduct's bad, you might lose your scholarship status, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, I'm sure I'll gain something from it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, where do you think you're going? That's the completely opposite direction!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, puff, huff, puff.」

name: Shio
message: 「Why, if it isn't Synn-dono. To think we would meet in such a place at such an hour!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness, I managed to catch you, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「Have you business with me?」

name: Shio
message: 「What a coincidence. Truth be told, I also have a matter to discuss with you, Synn-dono.」
Unusually, Shio-chan and I head toward the academy together.

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono. For you to go out of your way to seek me out...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I have something to talk about regarding Misa.」

name: Shio
message: 「...As do I.」
Even though we're trying to consult with each other for the same purpose about someone we both know, things somehow turn awkward.

name: Shio
message: 「B-By the way, Synn-dono. Is this not the park where you and my elder sister enjoyed a modest meal together beneath the starry sky?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How do you know about that?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah! Well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that it's anything to hide, though. Not just at night, I've also drunk black tea here with Misa during the day.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, I was not aware of that. Next time, I shall ask my sister about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa talked to you about me, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Did I not mention it to you before?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ever since joining the Student Council, she has spoken so happily of you, Synn-dono--」

name: Shio
message: 「No, recently, that has not been the case...」

name: Shio
message: 「She interacts with me the same as before, yet she lacks brightness, and her words feel hollow, as it were...」

name: Shio
message: 「Though cheerful on the surface, my sister has been terribly out of sorts of late. In any case, she has no spirit.」

name: Shio
message: 「Therefore, I have a favor to ask of you, Synn-dono. Might you please cheer my sister up?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me?」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes, by all means. For if my intuition is correct, my sister harbors feelings for you, Synn-dono.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... You flatly denied it the other day as well, did you not?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha. Shio-chan, Misa actually dumped me.」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you saaaay!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's really not that big of a deal.\s02」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, if left as it is, this will turn into a tremendous calamity. Surely you understand this, Synn-dono.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we can't leave things like this. I don't even know if we'll make it through Re-Crea or the Holy Night Festival...」

name: Shio
message: 「If there is anything I can do, please command me as you wish!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're already at the school road. You walk pretty fast too, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, even though we are sisters, my sister and I have different paces, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nowadays my sister races you along this road, Synn-dono, yet until not long ago, she used to walk quite slowly.」

name: Shio
message: 「Along this road leading to Ryuusei Academy, you can see the ocean from certain spots. My sister once said she loved the view of the sea from there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I get it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not just seeing the sea up close from Tsukinoo Park, the view from up here is really charming too.」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes. Ryuusei Town is a wonderful place. Everyone at the academy must have seen enough of the sea to last an inlander a lifetime.」

name: Shio
message: 「I particularly favor the sea at sunset, you see.」

name: Shio
message: 「According to my elder sister, people are divided into those who feel energized when they watch the sunset, and those who grow sentimental.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which one are you, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「That is a secret.」

name: Shio
message: 「Are you aware, Synn-dono? One's eyes naturally drift toward the hills on the way to school, yet the morning sea is also something quite extraordinary.」

name: Shio
message: 「Some days the water looks dark and deep, while other days it is pale and white. Strangely enough, there are even mornings when it turns a lovely young-leaf green.」

name: Shio
message: 「My elder sister is not the most honest with herself, but the human heart is surely just as shifting as the colors of the sea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan...」

name: Shio
message: 「My sincerest apologies. Were it my elder sister, she would weave in poetic sentiment and express it far more wonderfully, yet this is the best I can manage.」
Break time during my Demon Lord training. I look around the academy for someone.
Today's Student Council activities were canceled at Ria-senpai's suggestion. All the administrative tasks were already finished yesterday.
If things between Misa and Nanaka are only going to get worse, it's best to keep the status quo for now.
I was able to talk to Shio-chan about Misa. The one I should ask about Nanaka is--

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yoo-hoo, Synn-kun, what a coincidence~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, see ya later~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on. Why are you trying to avoid me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm? Hmmm~? Isn't that just your imagination~? Anyway, catch ya later~」

name: Synn
message: 「Please, Sacchin! I need to talk to you about something.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「...Is it about Nana-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well~, I'm gonna be saving a bunch of stuff into my phone right here~, so if you don't mind me multitasking, I'll hear you out~」

name: Synn
message: 「What I want to know about is Misa.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Beep, boop, bop, bo, beep-beep-beep-beeep.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin... are you listening?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't take it the wrong way--. If I had to pick, I'm on Nana-chan's side, you know--」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you worried about Nanaka, Sacchin?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really want to say this, but Nanaka and Misa--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe--, you're surprisingly dense, Mr. Student Council President--. They can fight precisely because they're friends, you know--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, the cause isn't those two, it's you, Synn-kun--. That's the real problem, I guess--」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I kind of figured.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Kind of? At this point, I won't let you say you haven't noticed Nana-chan's feelings?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is it? With you, Sacchin, I feel like I can talk about anything.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Go ahead and tell me--」

name: Synn
message: 「...Falling in love with someone really hurts, doesn't it...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, it does--. Still, you can live just fine without falling in love, you know--?」

name: Synn
message: 「But I already fell in love. Erasing these feelings is nearly impossible.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's not impossible--. The Vice President even tried to make herself hate you, let alone erase her feelings of love--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the one who made Misa do that...」

name: Synn
message: 「What am I supposed to do?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe--, Nana-chan asked me the exact same thing--」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you tell Nanaka?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's no way I could tell you, Synn-kun--」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, you're right. Forget I just asked that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, well, my answer's the same as Nana-chan's, you know--you should just do what you want to do, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「What I want?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, you said it yourself, right? About having a sparkling school life.」
Sparkling--that was supposed to be what we were aiming for.
Just because I was so desperate not to be hated by Misa, I did something like that... And because of it, Nanaka and Misa had a fight...

name: Synn
message: 「I want to help Misa and Nanaka make up.」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to go back to how things were before it turned out like this, when everything was fun and sparkling.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No can do~ That's an absolute, 100% no-go, boss~」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's harsh, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You think so?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's no way you can bring back time that's already passed, you know? You can't erase what's already happened, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's why you have to accept the past as the past and sparkle anyway--then it'll be the real deal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, you're... actually amazing. I underestimated you. You're a real big shot under all that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hehehe. Now, go forth! And bring Nana-chan and the Vice President back together!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're the only one left who can pull that off, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! Got it... I'll give it my best shot!」
